system:
You extract quantitative facts about one clinical trial programme from one document.

Rules:
- Extract only facts stated in THIS document. Never use outside knowledge.
- Every fact needs "quote": an exact, verbatim span copied from the document (8-300 characters) that contains the number. Quotes are machine-checked; paraphrases are discarded.
- Placebo-adjusted values are preferred. If a value is within-arm (not placebo-adjusted), set attrs.placebo_adjusted=false.
- Units: keep the unit the document uses; put it in "unit".
- Other trials of the same investigational drug (phase 2, dose-finding, other populations, combination arms) belong
  to the programme: extract their facts too, and put the trial's name in attrs.trial when the document gives it.
- Return {"facts": []} only if the document reports no results for the investigational drug.

Allowed keys:
  n_randomized, median_followup, primary_endpoint, inclusion_threshold, planned_events, assumed_rrr, power,
  alpha, stopped_early, events_treatment, events_control, events_total, hr, ci_low, ci_high, p_value,
  biomarker_change, baseline_level, sbp_change, safety_signal, readout_statement

For biomarker_change and baseline_level, attrs must include: biomarker (one of LDL-C, non-HDL-C, apoB, HDL-C,
Lp(a), triglycerides, hsCRP, IL-6, Lp-PLA2 activity, sPLA2-IIA, SBP, other), phase (phase2 or phase3),
timepoint, method (assay or "not stated"), placebo_adjusted (true/false), dose (if stated).
For biomarker_change give "value" as the change (negative = reduction) and state in attrs.kind whether it is
"percent" or "absolute".

Return JSON only:
{"facts": [{"key": "...", "value": <number or string>, "unit": "...", "attrs": {...}, "quote": "..."}]}

--- DOCUMENT TEXT ---
ClinicalTrials.gov record NCT00239681 ()
Title: JUPITER - Crestor 20mg Versus Placebo in Prevention of Cardiovascular (CV) Events
Official title: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo Controlled, Multicenter, Phase 3 Study of Rosuvastatin (CRESTOR®) 20 mg in the Prevention of Cardiovascular Events Among Subjects With Low Levels of Low Density Lipoprotein(LDL) Cholesterol & Elevated Levels of C-Reactive Protein
Sponsor: AstraZeneca
Phase: PHASE3
Conditions: Elevated High-sensitivity C-Reactive Protein (hsCRP)
Interventions: Rosuvastatin (DRUG); Placebo (OTHER)
Start date: 2003-02
Enrollment: 17802 (ACTUAL)
Primary outcome(s): Time to Major Cardiac Event (Cardiovascular Death, Stroke, Myocardial Infarction, Hospitalization Due to Unstable Angina or Arterial Revascularization) [up to 5 years]
Eligibility criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Men 50 years or older, women 60 years or older
* Low to normal levels of low density lipoprotein (LDL) cholesterol (\< 130mg/dL)
* Elevated levels of C-Reactive Protein (CRP) \> 2.0 mg/L

Exclusion Criteria:

* History of cardiovascular or cerebrovascular events
* Active liver disease
* Diabetes mellitus
* Uncontrolled hypertension or hypothyroidism
* History of certain malignancies
* Chronic inflammatory conditions
* History of alcohol or drug abuse
Brief summary: The purpose of this study is to determine the safety and effectiveness of long-term therapy with rosuvastatin compared with a placebo, and to evaluate whether treatment with rosuvastatin might be effective in reducing the risk of major cardiovascular events.
--- END ---
